title: Complete onboarding with profile criteria and a PDF/DOCX resume to reach parsed profile and initial results
description: Verifies that a signed-in user can complete onboarding by selecting region/direction/degree/visa needs, uploading a PDF/DOCX resume, and then see a parsed profile summary and initial job results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the dashboard
Select a region
Select a direction
Select a degree
Select a visa needs option
Upload a valid PDF or DOCX resume file
Submit onboarding
Verify a parsed profile summary is displayed
Verify job search results are displayed

title: Apply region and degree filters to refine Core Promise job results
description: Verifies that a returning user can apply region and degree filters on the dashboard and see the job list update while still showing only Core Promise–gated results.
category: Dashboard — Job Search & Core Promise Results

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the dashboard
Select a region filter option
Select a degree filter option
Verify the job results list reflects the selected filters and indicates jobs passed the Core Promise gate

title: Update direction or degree criteria and refresh results
description: Verifies that a user can update direction or degree criteria on the dashboard and see the job results refresh to match the updated criteria.
category: Dashboard — Job Search & Core Promise Results

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the dashboard
Select a different direction value
Select a different degree value
Submit the updated criteria
Verify the job results list updates to reflect the new criteria and indicates jobs passed the Core Promise gate

title: Submit a valid job URL in the demo verifier to see a verification result
description: Verifies that a visitor can submit a valid job URL in the demo verification widget and see a verification result state displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill a valid job posting URL into the demo job URL field
Submit the demo verification request
Verify a demo verification result state is displayed

title: Reject non-PDF/DOCX resume uploads during onboarding
description: Verifies that attempting to upload an unsupported resume format during onboarding shows a validation error and prevents completion.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to open the dashboard
Upload a resume file that is not a PDF or DOCX
Verify a resume file type validation error is visible

title: Reject malformed URLs in the demo verifier
description: Verifies that submitting an invalid or malformed URL in the demo widget shows a URL format validation message and does not show a verification result.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill an invalid URL string into the demo job URL field
Submit the demo verification request
Verify a URL validation error is visible
